statement: Every non-cog parent variable and constraint is retained by exact remapping. The original angle flags, stock intervals, mandatory counts, cog x order and all band cells are unchanged. Each physical cog pair selects a unique complete relative-Y bin. With its chosen phase pair, the retained sloping requirements imply every original rounded source face by the independent full-bin proof. Set each removed shared plane flag to its actual plane truth to extend the compact witness to every removed source implication and face OR. The substitute is sufficient, so a compact negative cannot be used as a full-source family exclusion.
